# Campaign 001 — launch

A frontmatter-less brief. `marketing.frontmatter` is monotonic, so it adds no
finding here — the brief declares no `marketing.type`.

## Overview

Announce the 1.0 release to the existing newsletter list and the docs-as-code
community.

## Success metrics

- Outcome: 200 trial installs in the 30 days after launch.
- Kill criteria: fewer than 20 installs in the first week.
